title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
text: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
text: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
text: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.

title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
text: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.

title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
text: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.

title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
text: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

title: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
text: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground for users to build browser-based games using simple text prompts.

title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
text: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.

title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
text: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

title: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
text: Playground is a new experimental gaming platform that lets you create, play, and share custom games.

title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
text: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
text: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
text: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.

title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
text: On Tuesday, Musubi announced a lightweight decision model made for real-time moderation called PolicyLM-1.7B, released with open weights.

title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
text: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.
